transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Sana. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Sana, I'm Sneha Wilson. I've been having a lot of trouble with my phone. It keeps restarting randomly and I can't get any work done.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that your device is causing you so much trouble, Ms. Wilson. I can certainly look into this for you.
Customer: I just want it fixed. It's incredibly frustrating.
Agent: I understand. Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide me with your account number?
Customer: Yes, my account number is 13559020.
Agent: Thank you. And just to confirm, is the phone number associated with the account 91068 52307?
Customer: That is correct.
Agent: Thank you for verifying that. I've checked the system and it looks like this might be a hardware failure. I'm going to escalate this to our technical hardware team for a deeper analysis.
Customer: Will they be able to fix it quickly?
Agent: They are the experts in this area. I will book a device check for you at our nearest service center so they can examine the hardware physically.
Customer: Okay, that sounds like a plan.
Agent: Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To recap, I have escalated your case to the hardware team and booked your device check. Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, and have a great day. Goodbye.
